findings: historical_glyphs.items[0].caption: The claim that this form “retains an enclosing crescent shape with an interior mark” conflicts with the attached oracle-script image, which shows a crescent outline and central stroke but no enclosed interior mark. Revise the caption to describe the visible strokes without asserting an interior mark; X-1c81afb18f3eecf4f987 identifies the image as a modern rendering of the cited Shang form, and X-7c0cfb18ccad95b89a39 supports the half-moon pictographic interpretation.
